newsitem.title: UK: EU seen awarding up to 100,000 T sugar at tender.
newsitem.headline: EU seen awarding up to 100,000 T sugar at tender.

text.p: The European Union (EU) is expected to award up to 100,000 tonnes of current series white sugar at its weekly tender later on Wednesday, traders said.
This week's authorised tonnage was forecast at between 70,000 and 100,000 tonnes, after the EU awarded 90,750 tonnes in its last tender on October 9.
Traders estimated the maximum restitution for licences this week at 45.057 Ecus (European Currency Units) per 100 kg of sugar, after last week's 44.940 Ecus.
Export licences are currently valid from October to March.
